summary: CMS powering 43% of the web — installed base is deeply embedded but AI site builders threaten new user acquisition.
moat: WordPress's moat is its installed base: powering 43% of all websites means millions of developers, agencies, and hosting providers have built their businesses on WordPress expertise. The plugin ecosystem with 59,000+ plugins creates switching costs so high that existing WordPress sites almost never migrate. However, new website creation — the acquisition pipeline — is increasingly captured by AI-native builders like Framer AI and Wix ADI that require zero technical knowledge.

challengers.name: AI website builders (Framer AI, Wix ADI, Squarespace AI)
challengers.evidence: Wix ADI and Framer AI can generate a complete, production-ready website from a text description in under 60 seconds, threatening the new-user acquisition funnel that WordPress depends on for ecosystem growth.
